name: Dusky Crab Cakes
summary: In Darkshire, Chef Grual prepares Dusky Crab Cakes for the hungry Jitters. The dish is a local delicacy, and Jitters finds it exquisite.

sections.title: A Questionable Delicacy
sections.body: Chef Grual prepares Dusky Crab Cakes for Jitters, a terrified vagrant overcome by hunger. Duskwood offers few fresh provisions, so cooks make do with meat from the forest. Grual’s cakes look like ordinary seafood patties, but their secret ingredient comes from the legs of Duskwood’s monstrous arachnids. Jitters devours the cakes, unaware of what he is eating.

faq.q: What are Dusky Crab Cakes actually made of?
aliases: what is in dusky crab cakes
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps his recipe to himself. The cakes’ secret ingredient comes to light while supplies are gathered for him in Duskwood.

faq.q: Who eats the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: Chef Grual prepares the cakes for Jitters, an anxious man sheltering at Raven Hill and complaining of a rumbling stomach.

faq.q: How does Jitters react to the cakes?
faq.answer: Starving, Jitters happily devours the cakes without questioning their recipe. He is grateful for a meal that satisfies his hunger.

faq.q: Who cooks the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: Chef Grual, the cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, prepares the cakes from supplies gathered for him.

angles.text: Grual’s cakes show how a cook can make a tangy local specialty from ingredients found in Duskwood.
